likely_causes.cause: Thermostat short-cycle or oversized setpoint swing
Dirty filter causing high head pressure trips
Failing start components or low charge

homeowner_checks: Give the system several minutes between manual thermostat changes
Confirm outdoor unit has clear airflow and shade from debris
Note how many starts you hear in an hour
tech_only: Safety switch or pressure control diagnosis
call_pro_when: More than a few compressor starts per hour continue after filter and thermostat checks.
assumptions: Thresholds in rules.json are starting placeholders
